subproblem.title: The support of an integer multiplicity cone is invariant under positive dilations
subproblem.statement: For all P, n ∈ ℕ and every C ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^P) that is integer multiplicity (IsIntegerMultiplicity C) and a cone (IsConeCurrent C, η_{0,λ#}C = C for λ > 0): for every t > 0 and every x ∈ spt C, t·x ∈ spt C.
subproblem.lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (C : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n), IsIntegerMultiplicity C → IsConeCurrent C → ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → ∀ x ∈ C.support, t • x ∈ C.support
subproblem.natural_proof:
Source: parent proof, preliminary (K) ("spt C is invariant under x ↦ sx, s > 0").
1. Let R ∈ IMRep univ n represent C (IsIntegerMultiplicity C) and μ := R.measure. By the accepted lemma `Submission.rsd_mem_support_iff_measure_ball_pos` (U := ℝ^P open, R represents C), z ∈ spt C ↔ (z ∈ ℝ^P and μ(B_r(z)) > 0 for every r > 0).
2. By the accepted lemma `Submission.cone_current_imrep_measure_smul_image` (C a cone represented by R, λ := t > 0), μ((z ↦ t z)(A)) = ENNReal.ofReal(tⁿ)·μ(A) for every Borel set A.
3. Let x ∈ spt C and r > 0. The homothety z ↦ t z maps B_{r/t}(x) onto B_r(t x) (Mathlib smul_ball: t • B_s(x) = B_{|t| s}(t • x) for t ≠ 0). Hence μ(B_r(t x)) = ENNReal.ofReal(tⁿ)·μ(B_{r/t}(x)), which is > 0 because tⁿ > 0 and μ(B_{r/t}(x)) > 0 (step 1, x ∈ spt C, r/t > 0).
4. By step 1, t x ∈ spt C. ∎
proof_key_steps: spt C = {z : μ_R(B_r(z)) > 0 ∀ r > 0} for a representation R (rsd_mem_support_iff_measure_ball_pos).
B_r(tx) = t·B_{r/t}(x), so μ_R(B_r(tx)) = tⁿμ_R(B_{r/t}(x)) > 0 and tx ∈ spt C.

audit.reason: The representation, homogeneous measure identity, and exact dilation of balls prove positivity of every ball about t • x. This gives the stated support inclusion for every positive t, without invoking the selected parent.
